The lesson for every team: Give every button text or an aria-label, so a screen reader can announce it.

windrawwin.com: 77. The gap: form labels.

Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 4 form controls have no label.

The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
